description: Runs ASR models exported to ONNX through the onnx-asr library. This fighter runs Qwen3-ASR 0.6B, a compact multilingual transformer ASR model.
notes: Only the base fp32 repo was found on HuggingFace; the -f16/-q8/-q5/-q4 sibling repos named in the request do not exist (404), so no separate quant-tier fighters were added.
